skill_name: Describe how artificial intelligence (AI) is impacting the field of healthcare.
workflow: AI is transforming healthcare in many ways, including improving patient health outcomes, shortening diagnosis and treatment cycles, reducing costs, and enhancing patient experience. AI-powered tools like image recognition to detect illnesses, virtual assistant for improved patient communication, and decision support systems to streamline medical decisions are helping medical professionals, researchers, and organizations process large amounts of data more efficiently and quickly.
